worldcombat.skill.hex.summary: Send a curse to the exact point locked in at cast, draw a fixed ring of sigils there, and erupt wave after wave of spectral spikes from within it. The sigil never chases anyone; every enemy caught on it is struck, and any that carries a status condition (burn, paralysis, poison, frozen, sleep) takes double on that hit.
worldcombat.skill.hex.description.0: Each wave of spikes deals about %1$s special damage to every enemy standing on the sigil; a target carrying any status condition (burn, paralysis, poison/toxic, frozen or sleep) takes double on that wave.
worldcombat.skill.hex.description.1: The curse travels up to %1$s blocks to the locked landing point and, on arrival, draws a fixed %2$s block radius sigil at %3$s travel speed; then %4$s waves erupt, %5$s apart.
worldcombat.skill.hex.description.2: Each wave settles once on every enemy still on the sigil and re-checks that target's status for the doubling; stepping out of the ring stops further hits, while stepping in later still catches one.
worldcombat.skill.hex.use.0: Lay a curse sigil under the foe
worldcombat.skill.hex.use.1: Finish a target carrying a status
worldcombat.skill.hex.use.2: Pin a clustered group at once
worldcombat.skill.hex.preference.chain.h: On: sigil radius ×1.35 to catch more foes, but each hit is ×0.85 and the cooldown is 3 ticks longer. Off: a tighter ring at ×1.08.
worldcombat.skill.hex.preference.ai.maxC: Beyond this distance the user closes in before laying the curse. Higher casts from further out.
worldcombat.skill.hex.preference.ai.blig: On: give afflicted targets extra priority. Off: keep the ordinary low priority without weighting the target's status.
worldcombat.skill.hex.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s, recover %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.hex.growth.0: From level %1$s: curse power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.hex.growth.1: From level %1$s: curse power %2$s, cast distance %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.hex.chain.on: Chain: the sigil spreads wider, each hit is held back.
worldcombat.skill.hex.chain.off: Focused: the sigil is tighter, each hit hits harder.
worldcombat.skill.hex.description.miss: The curse lands only on the aim point locked in at cast; if there is no supportable ground there, or the flight is cut off by a wall with nowhere to land, the sigil fizzles. A chosen target running away never drags it along.
